{{See also|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[StarFive]] JH7110 -U74x4 @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXE-4-32 @600MHz :(OpenGL ES3.2, OpenVG 1.2, Vulkan 1.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp30, :H.265 encoder up to 1080p30 *Storage: 16MB (SPI) Flash (''[[GigaDevice]]''), :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot, *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM (''[[Micron]]'') *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43456 ([[AMPAK AP6256]]) :802.11abgn/ac (1T1R) + BT 5.2 Combo SiP Module *Network: 1x GbE ports *PCIe: NGFF M.2 (Key M) socket w/ PCIe 2.0 *USB: 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB (Type-C) 2.0 ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V/4A via USB (Type-C)
